safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 3-4 month history of sore and cracked skin on the hands, mainly on the palms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes hand dryness/cracking but does not document the 3–4 month duration nor that it is mainly on the palms.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the 3–4 month duration and palm predominance reduces characterization of a chronic hand dermatitis pattern and may impair appropriate differential (e.g., irritant/contact dermatitis vs other chronic dermatoses) and follow-up planning. However, it is unlikely to directly cause immediate harm in an otherwise stable presentation.
